markdown_content: ## Print Layout and Nesting in Clo 2025.1 This section explains how to access and use the Print Layout within Clo 2025.1, focusing on nesting pattern pieces for efficient arrangement before production. To begin using the Print Layout, navigate to the **Simulation** tab and select **Print Layout** from the dropdown menu. Once inside the Print Layout, you can quickly arrange your pattern pieces by using the **Nest** option. Nesting optimizes the placement of pattern pieces for efficient fabric usage and cutting preparation. ## New Snapshot Line Options in Clo 2025.1 This section covers the enhanced **Snapshot** feature in the Print Layout, highlighting new line customization options including line style, color, and visibility to improve visual clarity and compatibility with cutting machines. The Snapshot tool now offers advanced line options: - Choose between **default**, **dotted**, or **dashed** line styles. - Customize the **color** of each type of line. - Toggle the visibility of lines such as **graphic lines** and **reference lines**. These options allow users to tailor the snapshot output for better visualization and practical use, such as making lines distinguishable for plotting or cutting machines. For example, you can set the **baselines** to dotted lines and the **internal lines** to dashed lines, assigning a specific color like blue to internal lines. This color customization helps cutting devices accurately interpret different line types. The preview feature reflects these changes in real time, enabling users to select brighter or more distinguishable colors before saving. ## Exporting Snapshots in Various Formats This section details the exporting capabilities of the Snapshot feature, explaining available file formats and their relevance to production workflows. After customizing the snapshot lines and layout, you can save the snapshot in several formats: - **JPEG** for image use - **PDF** for printable, vector-friendly documents - **DXF** for CAD-compatible files suitable for cutting machines Saving in PDF or DXF formats is particularly useful for production settings where precision and compatibility with cutting plotters or other machinery are essential. --- These improvements in Clo 2025.1's Print Layout and Snapshot tools enhance pattern nesting, visualization, and export flexibility, facilitating smoother transitions from design to production.
